SELECT base.id as main_id, base.tenant_id, base.factory_code, base.order_code, base.order_review_code, base.order_track_code, details.id, details.product_code, details.product_name, details.product_spec, details.product_unit, base.customer_code, base.customer_name, details.customer_part_code, base.order_type, details.state, base.order_state, details.deliver_num, details.deliver_time, details.change_sign, ROUND((details.deliver_num - details.delivered_num),2) as un_deliver_num FROM oms_order_base_track as base INNER JOIN oms_order_details as details ON base.order_code = details.order_code

AND base.order_code = #{query.projectOrderCode} AND details.factory_code = base.factory_code
AND base.order_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.orderCode},'%')
AND details.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.productCode},'%')
AND details.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.productName},'%')
AND details.product_spec LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.productSpec},'%')
